title: Grilled Melon and Mexican Street Corn
description: A sweet and savory summer recipe featuring grilled melon and Mexican street corn.
instructions: Soak melon balls in cold water for 30 minutes, then pat dry with paper towels.
Grill corn on cob for 10-12 minutes, turning frequently, or until slightly charred.
Meanwhile, mix together chipotle aioli, lime juice, and a pinch of salt and pepper in a small bowl.
Once corn is done, brush with chipotle aioli mixture.
Grill melon balls for 2-3 minutes per side, or until slightly caramelized.
To assemble, place a grilled melon ball on top of each corn on cob, then sprinkle with crumbled Cotija cheese and chopped cilantro.
Serve immediately and garnish with lime wedges.
